reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-sized sachet that tears open with one hand, because I keep forgetting my vitamins on the counter and a sachet can just live in my tote. I'd try one box of the plain bisglycinate, but only the one.
objection: $29.99 is a lot on my budget for something I might quit after two weeks, and the Complex only has 3 forms when other brands pack way more into one capsule.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller trial box, like 7 or 10 sachets, or a price closer to $22 for the 30.
